description: This file defines the DataDefinitionInterface interface for data definitions in Drupal, outlining methods for creating, retrieving, and managing data type metadata and constraints.

methods.name: createFromDataType
methods.description: Creates a new data definition object for a specified data type.

methods.name: getDataType
methods.description: Returns the data type of the data.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns a human-readable label for the data definition.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns a human-readable description of the data definition.

methods.name: isList
methods.description: Checks if the data is multi-valued (list).

methods.name: isReadOnly
methods.description: Checks if the data is read-only.

methods.name: isComputed
methods.description: Checks if the data value is computed.

methods.name: isRequired
methods.description: Checks if the data value is required.

methods.name: getClass
methods.description: Returns the class used for creating the typed data object.

methods.name: getSettings
methods.description: Returns the array of settings for the data definition.

methods.name: getSetting
methods.description: Returns the value of a specific setting.

methods.name: getConstraints
methods.description: Returns an array of validation constraints.

methods.name: addConstraint
methods.description: Adds a validation constraint to the data definition.

methods.name: isInternal
methods.description: Determines if the data value is internal and not exposed externally.
